dialogue.content: こんばんは。宜しくお願い致します。時間になりましたら、こちらから始めますね。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for being here. I'll get us started once it's time.

dialogue.content: こんばんは宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい。ボタン間違いました。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry. I pressed the wrong button.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。今日は相談に来てくださってありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I’m the counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願い致します。まず、最初に年齢と性別を教えていただけますか?
dialogue.English: You're welcome. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 18才、男
dialogue.English: 18, male.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。この相談であなたを何とお呼びすれば宜しいですか?ニックネームでもかまいませんよ。
dialogue.English: Thank you. What should I call you during our session? A nickname is fine, too.

dialogue.content: ひろや　です
dialogue.English: It's Hiroya.

dialogue.content: ひろやさんですね。今日はどのようなご相談ですか?
dialogue.English: Hiroya, I see. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 大学が始まったのですが、全然やる気が起きなくって
dialogue.English: University has started, but I have absolutely no motivation.

dialogue.content: 困ってます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling with it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 18歳ということは、この春ご入学されたんですか?
dialogue.English: Since you’re 18, does that mean you started university this spring?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: おめでとうございます。
dialogue.English: Congratulations.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 新しい生活が始まっているのに、やる気が起きないんですね。もどかしいですね。
dialogue.English: So even though a new life has begun for you, you're not feeling motivated. That must be frustrating.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたのお力になりたいので、少し詳しくお聴きしたいのですが、
dialogue.English: I'd like to support you, so I'd like to ask a bit more about the situation, if that's alright.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: やる気がでないというのは、どんな感じでいらっしゃいますか?
dialogue.English: When you say you have no motivation, what is that like for you?

dialogue.content: 大学に興味も無いし
dialogue.English: I’m not interested in university, either,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: やりたいことも見つからないまま入学を迎えたという感じです
dialogue.English: It feels like I started university without having found anything I want to do.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it was.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 焦ってしまいますね。
dialogue.English: That must make you feel anxious.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: 焦るというより
dialogue.English: It's not so much that I'm anxious,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 何もやる気出なくて、どうでもいいって感じです
dialogue.English: I have no motivation for anything, and I feel like nothing matters.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 大学に興味がない、ということでしたが、高校時代は進路についてどのように考えておられたのですか?
dialogue.English: You mentioned that you’re not interested in university. How did you think about your future path during high school?

dialogue.content: 第1希望の大学はあったのですが
dialogue.English: I did have a first-choice university,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 受験に失敗してしまって
dialogue.English: but I failed the entrance exam.

dialogue.content: （お聴きしています）
dialogue.English: (I’m listening.)

dialogue.content: 地元の三流大学しか受かりませんでした
dialogue.English: I only got into a third-rate local university.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.content: 最悪です
dialogue.English: It’s the worst.

dialogue.content: それで、そちらに進学されたんですね。
dialogue.English: And so you enrolled there.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 最悪、というのは、どんな感じですか?
dialogue.English: When you say "the worst," what does that feel like for you?

dialogue.content: 受験に失敗して
dialogue.English: Failing the exam...

dialogue.content: ええ、がっかりされましたよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, you must have been so disappointed.

dialogue.content: 親からは何でこんなことになったんだとか
dialogue.English: My parents say things like, "How could this have happened?"

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 人生終わったなとか
dialogue.English: and, "Your life is over."

dialogue.content: そんなことばかり言われて
dialogue.English: They kept saying things like that,

dialogue.content: つらくてたまりません
dialogue.English: and it’s unbearably painful.

dialogue.content: そんなことを言われたんですね。そうですね。ひろやさん自身が一番がっくり来ているのに。辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: They said those things to you. I understand. Especially when you're the one who is the most disappointed. That must be so painful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 受験後、すぐに今の大学への進学を決めたのですか?
dialogue.English: After the exams, did you decide to attend your current university right away?

dialogue.content: そこしか受からなかったので
dialogue.English: It was the only one I got into,

dialogue.content: 浪人はダメと言われてたので
dialogue.English: and I was told I wasn't allowed to take a year off to retake the exams.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…。何かご家庭の事情がおありなのでしょうが、ひろやさんはどうされたかったですか?
dialogue.English: I see... I imagine there were family circumstances, but what did you want to do, Hiroya?

dialogue.content: 出来ればもう一度挑戦出来たらよかったですが
dialogue.English: I would have liked to try again, if possible.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 浪人だけは絶対ダメだと
dialogue.English: But they said taking a year off was absolutely not an option.

dialogue.content: 頭悪い人間はダメだよねとか
dialogue.English: And things like, "People who aren't smart are worthless."

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。悔しかったですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been so frustrating.

dialogue.content: いつも聞かされていました
dialogue.English: I was told that all the time.

dialogue.content: お前の人生は終わったとかこんなことをずっ言われ続けるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are they going to keep telling me things like "your life is over" forever?

dialogue.content: そんなことを言われ続けると、前をむいて進む気に慣れないのは自然なことだと思います。苦しいですね。
dialogue.English: Being told things like that over and over again... it's only natural that you don't feel like you can look ahead and move forward. That must be very painful.

dialogue.content: はい、苦しいです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's painful.

dialogue.content: ひろやさんは、親御さんのそのような言葉を聴いて、どんな風に思われますか?
dialogue.English: Hiroya, how do you feel when you hear those words from your parents?

dialogue.content: 両親はどちらもエリート意識が高いので
dialogue.English: Both of my parents have a strong sense of elitism,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 当たり前のように頭の悪い人をけなしていました
dialogue.English: so they would always belittle people they considered unintelligent as a matter of course.

dialogue.content: だから
dialogue.English: So,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 自分がそっちの人になって
dialogue.English: now that I've become one of those people,

dialogue.content: （聴いています）
dialogue.English: (I'm listening.)

dialogue.content: そんなふうな扱いを受けるのは
dialogue.English: being treated that way...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: そうなんだろうなと思いました
dialogue.English: I thought that was probably what would happen.

dialogue.content: まさか自分が
dialogue.English: I never thought that I,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: of all people,

dialogue.content: 親からけなされるようになるなんて
dialogue.English: would be belittled by my own parents.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: こんなことが続けば
dialogue.English: If this continues,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 消えてしまいたいですね
dialogue.English: I just want to disappear.

dialogue.content: そこまで、追い詰められた気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.English: So you feel that pushed into a corner.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 深く傷きましたね。
dialogue.English: You’ve been deeply hurt.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう誰からも受け入れてもらえない
dialogue.English: I feel like no one will ever accept me now,

dialogue.content: と思ってしまいます
dialogue.English: that's what I can't help but think.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。そこまで言われると行き場を失いますよね。ちなみに大学受験までは、そのようなことはなかったのですか?
dialogue.English: I can understand that. Being told all that would make you feel like you have nowhere to turn. By the way, was it not like this before the university entrance exams?

dialogue.content: 一応高校での成績はいい方だったので
dialogue.English: My grades in high school were pretty good,

dialogue.content: 大丈夫でした
dialogue.English: so it was fine.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: なので、
dialogue.English: So,

dialogue.content: どうしてこんなことになったのか、という風に言われるんですね。
dialogue.English: that's why they say things like, "How did it come to this?"

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: ここまでのお話を一度まとめてみても宜しいですか?
dialogue.English: May I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ひろやさんは、第一志望の大学の受験に失敗し、浪人が許されないので、希望しない大学に入学された。親御さんからは、人生終わった、などと言われ、消えてしまいたいくらい辛い。
dialogue.English: Hiroya, you failed the entrance exam for your first-choice university, and since taking a year off to retake it wasn't an option, you enrolled in a university you didn't want to go to. Your parents have said things to you like "your life is over," and it's so painful you feel like you want to disappear.

dialogue.content: 親御さんはエリート意識も高く、以前から頭の悪い人をけなしているので、自分がそちらがわにいるように思われて、誰からも受け入れてもらえないと感じている。
dialogue.English: Your parents have a strong sense of elitism and have always belittled people they consider unintelligent, so you feel like you've now become one of those people and that you won't be accepted by anyone.

dialogue.content: 如何でしょうか?
dialogue.English: Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はい、そんな感じですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s about right.

dialogue.content: 今まで、お話を伺っていて、ひろやさんは、苦しい状況の中でも、何とかしなければならないと思われたからこそ、相談に来られた、とても真面目で誠実な方だと感じました。
dialogue.English: Listening to you so far, I get the sense that you are a very earnest and sincere person who came to this consultation precisely because you feel you have to do something, even in this painful situation.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: その真面目さや傷ついた気持ちを親御さんが受けとめてくださればいいのにな、と思いますが、どう思われますか?
dialogue.English: I wish your parents could accept your earnestness and your hurt feelings. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: そうですね、受け止めてもらったら、何か変わるかな
dialogue.English: Yes... If they accepted that, I wonder if something would change.

dialogue.content: 親がけなすようなこと
dialogue.English: The things my parents say to belittle me—

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 言わなくなりますかね
dialogue.English: I wonder if they'd stop saying them?

dialogue.content: だったらいいのですけと
dialogue.English: That would be nice, though.

dialogue.content: お話をお聴きして、ひろやさんは
dialogue.English: Listening to you, Hiroya,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 第一志望の大学に行けなかったこともあるとは思いますが、親御さんに否定されているように感じられて苦しんでおられるように感じました。如何ですか?
dialogue.English: I think that not getting into your first-choice university is part of it, but I also sense that you're suffering because you feel rejected by your parents. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: 今はどっちもありますが
dialogue.English: Right now, it's both,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 確かに親からのけなされる言葉がつらいです
dialogue.English: but it's true that the belittling words from my parents are painful.

dialogue.content: そうですね。一番応援していてほしい人たちですものね。
dialogue.English: I understand. They're the people you'd want cheering for you the most, after all.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですねでも今は
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. But now,

dialogue.content: 見放されていますね
dialogue.English: I feel like they've given up on me.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: どうしていいか、分からなくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: It makes you not know what to do, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 親御さんは、ひろやさんのそんな気持ちをご存知ですか?
dialogue.English: Do your parents know that you feel this way?

dialogue.content: はい、これから先ずっと
dialogue.English: Yes... and from now on, forever,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 負け組で生きていくのかなって
dialogue.English: I wonder if I'm going to have to live my life as a 'loser.'

dialogue.content: 思うと恐いです
dialogue.English: That thought scares me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: たぶん自分の気持ちは知らないです
dialogue.English: They probably don’t know how I feel.

dialogue.content: 人生大学で決まらないって
dialogue.English: I told them that your life isn't decided by the university you go to,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どこに就職するかだと言っても
dialogue.English: but by the company you work for,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 笑われておわりでした
dialogue.English: but they just laughed at me and that was the end of it.

dialogue.content: そんな風に言われたことがあったんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's what happened when you said that to them.

dialogue.content: はい、こんな大学からいいとこに就職出来る訳ないって言ってます
dialogue.English: Yes, they say there’s no way I can get a good job from a university like this.

dialogue.content: 希望をつなげようとしているのに・・・
dialogue.English: Even though you’re trying to hold on to hope...

dialogue.content: 話すのも苦痛になりますね。
dialogue.English: It must be painful to even talk to them.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 全否定ですね
dialogue.English: It's a complete rejection of me.

dialogue.content: 私は、あなたはもっと大切な存在だと思います。
dialogue.English: I believe you are a much more valuable person than that.

dialogue.content: 大学名などであなたの価値ははかれるものではありません。
dialogue.English: Your worth cannot be measured by something like the name of your university.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 確かに、世間では偏差値や大学名で人を判断する人もいますが、
dialogue.English: It's true that some people in the world judge others by their test scores or university names,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こうして自分の人生を一生懸命生きようとして相談に来られるひろやさんはとても素晴らしい方だと思います。
dialogue.English: but I think that you, Hiroya, are a truly wonderful person for trying so hard to live your own life that you came here for a consultation.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 自分は一生懸命なんでしょうか
dialogue.English: Am I really trying that hard?

dialogue.content: どう思われますか?私は、もうどうでもいいや、と本当に思われていたとしたら、相談にも来られないと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: What do you think? If you truly felt that you didn't care about anything anymore, I don't think you would have come for this consultation.

dialogue.content: まあ、そうかもしれません
dialogue.English: Well, that might be true.

dialogue.content: つらくてここにきました
dialogue.English: I came here because it was too painful.

dialogue.content: そうですね。何とか辛さから脱出して、やる気を出せるようになりたいと思われたから来られたんですよね。
dialogue.English: That's right. You came here because you want to somehow escape this pain and be able to find your motivation again, correct?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここまで
dialogue.English: So far,

dialogue.content: お話されてみて如何でしたか?
dialogue.English: how have you felt talking about all of this?

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいかまだ答えは見つかっていませんが
dialogue.English: I still haven't found an answer for what I should do, but

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 誰にも言えない悩みを話せたので、少しすっきりしました
dialogue.English: I was able to talk about worries I couldn't tell anyone else, so I feel a little bit better.

dialogue.content: 少しすっきりされたとしたら良かったです。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear you feel a little better.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 私はひろやさんの味方です。
dialogue.English: I’m on your side, Hiroya.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そして、ひろやさんの一番の味方は
dialogue.English: And your biggest supporter...

dialogue.content: 誰でもない、ひろやさんご自身だと思っています。
dialogue.English: ...is none other than you yourself, Hiroya.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうぞ、困難の中にも進もうとされているご自身を認めてあげていただければと思います。
dialogue.English: Please, I hope you can acknowledge that part of you that is trying to move forward even in these difficult times.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: ひろやさんの人生は、そんなひろやさんが切り開いていけると信じています。
dialogue.English: I believe that you are the one who can carve out your own path in life.

dialogue.content: 今日は時間になってしまいました。
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up for today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 本日の相談はこれで終了させていただいて宜しいですか?
dialogue.English: Is it alright if we end today’s session here?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s fine.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談ありがとうございました。また、是非お話にいらしてください。お待ちしています。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your consultation today. Please feel free to come and talk again. I'll be here for you.

dialogue.content: はい、また相談にきます
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ll come again for a consultation.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。失礼します。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした！)
dialogue.English: (Good work today!)

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。ロールプレイを終了しますね）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work today. We’ll end the role-play here.)

dialogue.content: (はい、勉強になりました。失礼致します)
dialogue.English: (Yes, this was a great learning experience. Thank you. Goodbye.)

dialogue.content: （失礼します）
dialogue.English: (Goodbye.)
